accepted.reason: exec_command is an explicitly authorized full-profile shell boundary; the runtime validates size and NUL bytes, invokes a fixed platform shell, and documents that commands execute with the local user's authority.

run_process and exec_command intentionally accept caller-selected executable or shell input after PolicyGate authorization; child_process.spawn receives argv separately and shell mode remains disabled at the spawn boundary.

The shared internal executable runner always uses spawn with shell false and a separately validated argv array; explicit shell parsing is constructed only by workspaceShellCommand at the authorized exec_command boundary.
Environment-derived paths are passed as discrete argv values to spawn with shell false; executable and argument strings reject NUL bytes and are bounded before process creation.
